answer: Plant honeypots in the grading queue. Each epoch, 5% of answers a grader sees are protocol-made decoys with a hidden flaw, like a wrong sum or a missing required word. Approving one costs that epoch's reward and a quarter of grading weight; three misses in ten epochs revokes grading. A puppet that rubber-stamps 20 reviews per epoch meets about one decoy each time, so its weight hits its nadir within three epochs. A decoy passes for quartz at a glance; honest readers who walk the meadow slowly spot the glass.
